metadata.boundary: Working Pride in Place boundary (from 9 Oct 2026) = published MSOA E02005617 'North Northamptonshire 007' (Kingswood and Hazel Leys) + the Exeter estate LSOAs E01026951 (005C) and E01026950 (005B, incl. Burghley Drive NN18 8DX). The two Exeter LSOAs sit in MSOA E02005616, outside the published MSOA.
metadata.exeter_data: Exeter LSOAs are not in the Aug data pack: IMD 2025 for 005C from the pack, for 005B from the MHCLG Local Deprivation Explorer; Census 2021 for both from Nomis using the pack's method.
metadata.claimant: Claimant rate = ONS published claimants as a proportion of residents aged 16-64, July 2026 (Nomis NM_162_1), for all nine LSOAs. Whole-area rate is approximate.
metadata.data: Pride in Place Corby - Deprivation Data Pack.xlsx (compiled Aug 2026): IMD 2025 ranks of 33,755 (1 = most deprived); Census 2021 by LSOA; claimant count Jul 2026.
metadata.town: Corby Town Council area: the 37 LSOAs inside Corby civil parish (ONS OA21 to parish lookup). Wards are the four parish wards set by SI 2024/157, drawn as the May 2025 NNC wards clipped to the parish (ONS WD_MAY_2025_UK_BGC_V2, PARNCP_DEC_2025_EW_BGC).

months.bus: timetables valid from 22 Oct 2026, counted for Tue 3 Nov, Sat 7 Nov and Sun 8 Nov 2026

metadata.epc: EPC register (MHCLG 'Get energy performance of buildings data'), domestic full-load CSV regenerated 2026-10-13. Latest certificate per property (by UPRN, or by address where there is no UPRN), then each property placed in an LSOA through its postcode (postcodes.io, 2021 LSOAs). Rates are of homes with a certificate, not of all homes. North Northants and England use the same method on every certificate in the file (England = local authority codes starting E).
metadata.health: OHID Fingertips, Local Health profile (area type MSOA): life expectancy at birth by sex (indicator 93283, 2019-23), reception (93105) and Year 6 (93107) obesity, 2022/23-24/25 (3 years combined), and emergency hospital admissions, all causes, standardised admission ratio (93227, 2016/17-20/21, England = 100). Values are for the MSOA (a wider area of several neighbourhoods) that each LSOA sits in, matched through postcodes.io msoa21 codes. Pride in Place and Corby town figures are population-weighted averages of the neighbourhoods' MSOA values (approximate). North Northants and England are Fingertips' own values. Healthy life expectancy at birth by sex (indicator 94359, 2019-23, Census 2021 based) is handled the same way.
metadata.bus: Bus Open Data Service (DfT) GTFS timetable feed for the East Midlands, feed version 20261022_034732. Scheduled departures counted per stop for Tue 3 Nov 2026 (weekday), Sat 7 Nov and Sun 8 Nov 2026, using calendar and calendar_dates; stops with no pick-up are ignored. 'Homes within 400 m' uses straight-line distance from each address postcode (postcodes.io) to a stop, weighting each postcode by the number of homes with an energy certificate (a stand-in for homes). North Northants uses the same method on all its postcodes; England is not calculated (it would need every region's timetables). Weekday daytime = departures 07:00 to 18:59; 'good' = at least 24 (2 an hour); evening = at least 4 weekday departures from 19:00.
metadata.roads: DfT road safety data (STATS19), collisions and casualties 2021-2025 (dft-road-casualty-statistics-*-last-5-years.csv; no key needed). Police-reported collisions with injury only. Collisions placed in LSOAs by their coordinates (point in polygon). Casualty rates per 1,000 residents use Census 2021 populations, summed over the five years; North Northants (local_authority_ons_district E06000061) and England (E codes) use the same counts and Census 2021 populations (359,525; 56,490,048). Killed or seriously injured = casualty_severity 1 or 2.
metadata.stopsearch: data.police.uk /stops-force for Northamptonshire, Sep 2025 to Aug 2026 (12 months), stops with a location placed in LSOAs by point in polygon (locations are anonymised to nearby map points). Stops with no location are left out. No North Northants or England comparison: the force covers North and West Northamptonshire and England would need every force.
metadata.food: Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme open API (api.ratings.food.gov.uk, version 2, no key), North Northamptonshire (local authority 70), fetched 2026-10-30. Premises placed in LSOAs by their geocode (or, where missing, their postcode centroid from postcodes.io), point in polygon; premises outside the 37 LSOAs (industrial estates, villages) are not counted. Rated = a numeric 0-5 rating (awaiting inspection and exempt premises are left out of the percentages). Takeaways = FSA business type 'Takeaway/sandwich shop' (all statuses). England = the 298 English local authorities in the FSA scheme (fetched via filtered counts per authority); per-1,000 rates use Census 2021 populations (359,525; 56,490,048).
